title: Prisma #29190: TypeError Cannot read properties of null in timestamp parser for nullable columns

error_signal.message: prisma TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'replace') in normalize_timestamp when querying nullable DateTime columns with null values

ground_truth.root_cause_description: PPG adapter passes null values through to type parsers for nullable columns. normalize_timestamp calls .replace() on the value without checking for null first.
ground_truth.fix_description: Add null guards to normalize_timestamp, normalize_timestamptz, normalize_timez, and normalize_money parser functions
